scenario.name: Individual requests access to personal information
steps: Given the entity holds personal information about the individual
When the individual requests access to their personal information
Then the privacy policy states that the individual will be given access to their personal information upon request
scenario.derives_from: the entity must, on request by the individual, give the individual access to the information.

verdict_2016.evidence_quote: you can view or edit your personal data online for many Microsoft services.
verdict_2016.reasoning: The policy explicitly states that individuals can view or edit their personal data, which implies access to their personal information upon request.

scenario.name: No charge for access request
steps: Given the individual requests access to their personal information
When the individual makes the request
Then the privacy policy states that the individual will not be charged for making the request
scenario.derives_from: the entity must not charge for making of the request.
